onboarding.sub.prereqs: One run installs everything AIOS uses — Homebrew, Git, Node, Obsidian and Claude Code. Safe to run again; it skips whatever you already have.
onboarding.sub.login: Claude is the AI that does the work here — every ritual, every agent, every session runs through your Claude account. Log in in the browser, then answer the few questions Claude asks in the terminal (press Enter, pick a theme). Leave that window open until this step ticks itself green: those questions only appear once, and getting them out of the way now is what keeps them from interrupting the setup later.
onboarding.sub.github: Git is version control: a full history of every change, so nothing is ever lost and anything can be undone. That matters more than usual here, because AI moves fast and writes a lot — GitHub is where your vault is backed up and where you can always see what changed.
onboarding.sub.firstrun: With Claude and GitHub ready, a Claude session takes it from here and handles the rest — your vault (fresh, or bringing one you already have), the wiring, the tools you want, and the interview that teaches it who you are. It asks before it changes anything, and finishes by planning your day.
